summary: Preserved candidate PR https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2749 and corrected both concrete counterexamples from review PR https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/3139: Cosmos3 latent preparation now constructs the effective candidate batch and draws video, action, and sound noise with per-candidate generators instead of passing a generator list to torch.randn.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate commit failed before denoising with TypeError because torch.randn received generator=list; it also reported one conditioning item for two logical candidates. Raw output: reports/j-c4963c57423a/failing_before.txt

155 tests and 43 subtests passed, including single-conditioning-image candidate expansion, exact per-seed sequential RNG parity, reducer behavior, API lowering, and Cosmos3 compatibility. Raw output: reports/j-c4963c57423a/pytest_focused_after.txt
The corrected stage constructs physical latent batch size 2 for two candidate generators. Raw output: reports/j-c4963c57423a/passing_after.txt

On AMD Instinct MI350X, a two-candidate physical latent batch was bitwise equal to independent sequential per-seed torch.randn references and the candidates were distinct. Raw output: reports/j-c4963c57423a/gpu_numerical.txt
Changed Python sources compile and the patch has no whitespace errors. Ruff was unavailable in the pinned interpreter.

gpu_evidence: reports/j-c4963c57423a/gpu_numerical.txt records AMD Instinct MI350X execution, physical_latent_batch=2, sequential_parity=True, and candidate_distinct=True.
remaining_limitations: Cosmos3 action model weights were unavailable, so end-to-end Cosmos3 serving and semantic action quality were not tested.
TP/SP, CFG-parallel, cancellation/failure recovery, unrelated-request dynamic co-batching, and N={1,2,4,8,10} model benchmarks remain unverified.
The GPU check qualifies latent RNG and physical batch construction only; it does not qualify the unavailable Cosmos3 architecture or weights.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
